mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_pass (student_id, center_code, product_id, service_code, source, ref_no, billing_ym, valid_from, valid_until, total_count, remain_count, granted_at) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{centerCode}, #{productId}, #{serviceCode}, #{source}, #{refNo}, #{billingYm}, #{validFrom}, #{validUntil}, #{totalCount}, #{totalCount}, DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()))
mapper.sql: pass_id, student_id, center_code, product_id, service_code, source, ref_no, billing_ym, valid_from, valid_until, total_count, remain_count, granted_at, revoked_at
mapper.select: SELECT TOP 1 FROM erp_bookstore_pass WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND service_code = #{serviceCode} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND remain_count > 0 AND (valid_from IS NULL OR (valid_from <= #{date} AND valid_until >= #{date})) ORDER BY CASE WHEN valid_from IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, valid_until ASC, granted_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_bookstore_pass SET valid_from = #{startDate}, valid_until = DATEADD(DAY, #{addDays}, #{startDate}) WHERE pass_id = #{passId} AND valid_from IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE erp_bookstore_pass SET valid_from = NULL, valid_until = NULL WHERE pass_id = #{passId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE erp_bookstore_pass SET remain_count = remain_count - 1 WHERE pass_id = #{passId} AND remain_count > 0 AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_bookstore_pass_use (pass_id, student_id, reservation_id, used_date, created_at) VALUES (#{passId}, #{studentId}, #{reservationId}, #{usedDate}, DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()))
mapper.select: SELECT use_id AS useId, pass_id AS passId, student_id AS studentId, reservation_id AS reservationId, used_date AS usedDate FROM erp_bookstore_pass_use WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} AND canceled_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_bookstore_pass SET remain_count = remain_count + 1 WHERE pass_id = #{passId} AND remain_count < total_count AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE erp_bookstore_pass_use SET canceled_at = DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()) WHERE use_id = #{useId} AND canceled_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT ISNULL(SUM(remain_count), 0) FROM erp_bookstore_pass WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND service_code = #{serviceCode} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND (valid_from IS NULL OR (valid_from <= CAST(DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()) AS DATE) AND valid_until >= CAST(DATEADD(HOUR, 9, GETUTCDATE()) AS DATE)))

SELECT MIN(valid_from) AS cycleFrom, MAX(valid_until) AS cycleUntil, ISNULL(SUM(total_count), 0) AS capacity, ISNULL(SUM(remain_count), 0) AS remaining FROM erp_bookstore_pass WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND service_code = #{serviceCode} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND (valid_from IS NULL OR (valid_from <= #{date} AND valid_until >= #{date}))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM erp_bookstore_pass_use WHERE pass_id = #{passId} AND canceled_at IS NULL
